content.subject: Quick thought on fulfillment partnerships
content.draft_text:
Hi AJ,

I read your post about choosing the right fulfillment partner and the note about avoiding the cheapest trap stuck with me. Your point about long‑term partnership resonated.

Many e‑commerce brands lose time when order data and shipping updates don’t line up. The resulting manual checks can slow growth. Frequent check‑ins prevent those issues.

We build bots that match fulfillment data to sales records, removing manual reconciliation.

Would eliminating that back‑and‑forth be helpful for you?

Zamp
